$comment: NOT a golden manifest. Each entry records how WRONG our SEQUENCE-engine SVG emission is today against the jar oracle under DeterministicMeasurer, measured by tests/oracle/svg-conformance/sequence.diff-baseline.ratchet.test.ts over the committed corpus at test-results/dot-cache/sequence/<slug>/{in.puml,in.svg} (D4 -- no SVG is copied here). Rendered WITH the vendored-stdlib include store, identical to the one scripts/svg-conformance-census.ts:168 uses, so this gate and the census measure the same population; without it <tupadr3/common.puml> and <logos/centos> error instead of resolving. See plans/sequence-oracle-harness/decisions.md D2. THE GATED QUANTITY IS weightedScore, NOT diffCount -- amended 2026-08-23 (D5, plans/sequence-root-chrome/decisions.md). compareNodes short-circuits in three places (node-type, tag and child-count mismatch) and used to charge exactly 1 for each however large the subtree it skipped, so a document that got MORE structurally aligned could RAISE its diff count. compare.ts now charges each short-circuit an upper bound on what descending could have cost, and weightedScore sums those charges; it is monotone in alignment. diffCount is kept as an INFORMATIONAL field and is never gated -- a RISEN diffCount beside a FALLEN weightedScore is the expected artefact of that weighting, not a failure. A rise vs the recorded weightedScore FAILS the gate; it has no benign reading with respect to alignment. It is NOT monotone in our document GROWING toward the oracle, because the weight sums both sides: correct-but-not-yet-matching content raises the unexplained total until the child counts actually match (D7 names the nine fixtures where that happened and why). A fall logs [IMPROVED]; reaching 0 logs [PROMOTION READY] and does nothing else -- promotion into ratchet.json is stop 13 of the sequence-oracle-harness mission and is NEVER automatic. A status:"error" entry carries a reason and a null diffCount, never a number: a fixture that stops erroring is a reportable change, not "reached 0 diffs". Do not hand-edit weightedScore or diffCount to make the suite pass: re-run the measurement and change weightedScore, diffCount, measuredAt and measuredAgainstCommit together.
